title: Hyperspace
description: Jumping between systems and Reaches. The feature document, hyperspace.md, is the primary record.

entities.name: Hyperspace jump
entities.description: The pilot picks a system on a chart, starts the countdown, survives it and arrives somewhere new.
entities.behavior: The hyperspace key checks, in order: docked, a countdown running, then selects the system nearest the chart cursor and refuses it when it is here or beyond the fuel; otherwise the 85-tick countdown starts. When it ends the destination's distance is taken from the fuel, the mis-jump byte is drawn and the 16-tick tunnel plays; on arrival the market byte is drawn, the flight state is reset, legal status is halved and the planet and sun are placed.
entities.outcome: A new system, a new market and new dangers.
constraints: COUNTDOWN_TICKS is 85; the tunnel is 16 steps.
Fuel never goes below 0, and retargeting a running countdown is range-checked (deliberate difference 6).

entities.name: Reach jump
entities.description: A galaxy drive, used once, carries the pilot to the next Reach.
entities.behavior: With a galaxy drive fitted and no countdown running, the key uses the drive up and clears legal status at once and starts the countdown in galactic mode; the jump moves the pilot to the next Reach.
constraints: Needs Fitted::galaxy_drive; it is used up at the press.

entities.name: Mis-jump into the Deep
entities.description: Three times in 256 a normal jump drops the pilot into the Deep among the aliens.
entities.behavior: When the drawn mis-jump byte says so, the arrival is the ambush: no planet, no station, alien motherships and their drones around the pilot, and the current system's name blank.
entities.outcome: Danger the pilot cannot rule out.
constraints: The mis-jump test is the universe capability's is_misjump.

relatedViews.relationship: The pilot's goals that exercise it.
Distance, range, selection, the Reach jump and the mis-jump test.
The market byte drawn on arrival.
